patch_description:
The current approach uses 16 Gaussian starts, 1500 iterations per start, a squared-distance soft-extrema temperature schedule from 0.09 to 0.025, and normalized gradient steps from 0.045 downward. Its main limitation is that most random starts do not begin near strong diameter-packing contact graphs.

The new configuration uses a structured portfolio centered on staggered two-ring-plus-pole layouts, with varied ring radii, layer heights, angular twists, and pole positions, plus distorted cube-axis seeds and a small number of reproducible random starts. Each seed receives an annealed log-distance soft-extrema continuation with momentum, retaining the best exact squared ratio throughout. A final sharper continuation polish is applied to the best candidate, emphasizing the active closest and farthest pairs while preserving the best exact configuration encountered. The search uses 10 starts, 1700 continuation iterations, sharpness increasing from 5 to 260, momentum 0.84, and a final 1200-step high-sharpness polish.
